text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Um, Rob Roy-san... Thank you so much for 
the birthday present. I... read the book 
you gave me...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Waah, you've read it already?! An epic 
novel depicting the historic clashes 
between legendary Umamusume—how was it?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...The first... few pages. ...Such a 
magnificent race scene... I just... 
couldn't bring myself to read any 
further..."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
You can't get through it...? U-Um, was 
it... hard to read? I-I'm so sorry, 
picking it based purely on my own taste—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"OPON"... Neo Universe "browsed" it as 
well. It is very "intriguing"—isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Still in Love, the "things you want to 
say" ..."Moon's shadow." Shall we "lift 
off"?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
U-Um... no...! It really is the best 
present ever...! I've been rereading the 
race scenes over and over again.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Giving it everything under the gaze of a 
roaring crowd... pushing my throat to its 
absolute limit... the lingering taste of 
iron. ...I want to be driven by that sheer 
bitterness...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
!! You liked it!? The duel between the two 
at the start is so good, right?! The way 
that explosive late charge overwhelmed the 
rest was just magnificent!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(Yes, yes...! Seizing desperate, fleeing 
prey... with bared fangs—time and time 
again...!)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(Aah, how unseemly...! —And yet, and yet, 
I'm tingling too... I want to devour 
someone right this instant...!!)
